title: Affine torsion cohomological dimension with an explicit dimension bound
statement: Let K be a field and c,d natural numbers. Suppose Spec K has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most c, in the derived-section convention [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Let X be an affine finite-type K-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with topological Krull dimension at most d [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then X has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d+c in that convention, including when X is empty.

source.place: Nonempty dimension bound and the all-degree empty-scheme clause of thm-sc-affine-torsion-cd

proof.text: Apply thm-sc-affine-torsion-cd to obtain its nonempty dimension-plus-c bound and its separate empty-scheme clause. If X is empty, the latter gives vanishing in every degree and in particular above d+c.

If X is nonempty, apply WithBot.unbotD_le_iff with default zero to the assumed inequality dim X <= d, then ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast. This gives ((dim X).unbotD 0).toNat <= d. For q>d+c, transitivity and Nat.add_le_add_right imply q>((dim X).unbotD 0).toNat+c; apply the nonempty clause to each torsion sheaf. The argument includes d=0.

proof_origin.place: Fully proved numerical-dimension and empty-scheme variant requested by the returned delivery
